questions.q_en: Jack stands 75m to the north of Hilson, who stands 125m to the south of John. Peter stands 50m to the west of Jack. Azim stands 50m to the north of Peter. After meeting John, Potter walked 25m to the west and turns towards left. After meeting Mr. B who is standing 25m to the west of Jack, Mr. Potter stop at Peter. Then the total distance covered by Mr. Potter is ____.
questions.solution_en:
Jack stands 75m to the north of Hilson, who stands 125m to the south of John. Peter stands 50m to the west of Jack. Azim stands 50m to the north of Peter.

After meeting John, Potter walked 25m to the west and turns towards left. After meeting Mr. B who is standing 25m to the west of Jack, Mr. Potter stop at Peter.

Then the total distance covered by Mr. Potter is 25+52+25 = 100m.

questions.q_en:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the equation correct?

120 ÷ 4 + 3 - 5 X 2 = 37
questions.solution_en:
Option (a) If ÷ and x signs are interchanged, then the equation will be:

120 x 4 + 3 - 5 ÷ 2 = 37

480 + 3 - 2.5 = 37

483 - 2.5 = 37

480.5 ≠ 37

Thus, the equation is not balanced.

Option (b) If + and - signs are interchanged, then the equation will be:

120 ÷ 4 - 3 + 5 X 2 = 37

30 - 3 + 10 = 37

40 - 3 = 37

37 = 37

Thus, the equation is balanced. So, option (b) is correct.

Option (c) If + and x signs are interchanged, then the equation will be:

120 ÷ 4 x 3 - 5 + 2 = 37

30 x 3 - 5 + 2 = 37

90 - 5 + 2 = 37

92 - 5 = 37

87 ≠ 37

Thus, the equation is not balanced.

Option (d) If - and ÷ signs are interchanged, then the equation will be:

120 - 4 + 3 ÷ 5 X 2 = 37

120 - 4 + 1.2 = 37

121.2 - 4 = 37

117.2 ≠ 37

Thus, the equation is not balanced.

questions.solution_en:
It is given that,

Seven friends are A, B, C, D, E, F, and G.

A is the shortest among all. Only four people are taller than C.C is taller than D.

We get,

__ > __ > __ > __ > C > D > A

E is taller than G but shorter than F. F is not the tallest.

We get,

B > F > E > G > C > D > A

Here, there are two people between the heights of B and G.
